about: PRIVATE recorded range suite. One explicit grid for desktop and phone.

blocks.intro: Measure your own comfortable range first.

cells.cue: LOWEST comfortable hum; do not strain · hold about 2 s
HOME note; a relaxed normal hum · hold about 2 s
HIGHEST comfortable hum; do not strain · hold about 2 s
WHISTLE home; a relaxed whistle · hold about 2 s

blocks.intro: Room. Stay quiet for 3 seconds (no talking, humming or tapping): this measures the room's noise, like the app's calibration room step.

cells.cue: Stay quiet for 3 seconds

blocks.intro: Remain silent for each 60 second recording.

cells.name: media-30
cells.cue: Play a Reel/Short on phone or laptop speakers at 30%; stay silent for 60 s

cells.name: media-60
cells.cue: Play a Reel/Short on phone or laptop speakers at 60%; stay silent for 60 s

cells.name: media-90
cells.cue: Play a Reel/Short on phone or laptop speakers at 90%; stay silent for 60 s

cells.name: tv
cells.cue: Play TV or music across the room; stay silent for 60 s

cells.name: fan
cells.cue: Run a fan; stay silent for 60 s

cells.name: talk
cells.cue: Play people talking (a podcast); stay silent for 60 s

cells.name: typing-kitchen
cells.cue: Typing or kitchen sounds; stay silent for 60 s

short.about: About 8 minutes, e.g. for a second speaker: the range step, the room step, contours at centre + pitch bottom + loud soft + dist across, discrete at centre + soft + across (one rep each), combos at centre x 2; no backgrounds or real checks.
